title: Libido Support Strips
body_html:
Add a little extra vitality to your wellness routine with our Libido Support Strips, specially crafted for adults looking to maintain healthy energy, stamina, and sexual wellness as part of a balanced lifestyle. These convenient, chocolate-flavored oral strips dissolve easily on the tongue, offering a simple and discreet way to support everyday well-being.


Each strip delivers a blend of Cordyceps militaris, Shilajit, and Oyster Peptide — ingredients traditionally valued for their role in supporting normal endurance, energy metabolism, and the wellness of sexual function. Cordyceps militaris is often associated with promoting stamina and vitality, while Shilajit provides naturally occurring minerals that help support normal physical function, including sexual wellness. Oyster Peptide contributes natural amino acids that play a role in general wellness and normal nutrient balance.*


To use, simply place one rich chocolate-flavored strip on your tongue and allow it to dissolve. Take one strip per day to support your energy, vitality, and overall wellness as part of your healthy lifestyle.


Ingredients: Cordyceps Militaris (50 mg), Asphaltum Punjabianum (Shilajit) (50 mg), Oyster Peptide (20 mg), Pullulan, Cellulose, Monk Fruit Extract, Lecithin, Chocolate Flavor, Erythritol, Sorbitol, Pectin, Steviol Glycosides

Flavor: Chocolate

Manufacturer's country: India

Product amount (oz/lbs/g): 30 Strips / 1.2 oz / 0.07 lbs / 33 g

Gross weight (oz/lbs/g): 2.24 oz / 0.14 lbs / 64 g

Suggested use: Place one oral strip on your tongue and allow it to dissolve before swallowing. Take one oral strip anytime, up to a maximum of 1 strip a day.

Warning: Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if the safety seal is damaged or missing. Store in a cool, dry place.

Caution: Do not exceed recommended dose. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under the age of 18, and individuals with a known medical condition should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement.


*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
